description: What American households expect, from the New York Fed's Survey of Consumer Expectations, monthly: inflation over one, three and five years, home prices, the prices of gas, food, rent, medical care and college, earnings, income and spending, and the chances of losing or finding a job, of higher unemployment, of missing a debt payment and of stocks rising; the latest month beside a month and a year before, or one topic month by month. No key.

months.description: topic: months shown, latest last; default 13.

topic.description: One topic month by month, every measure the survey gives for it (medians, quartiles): inflation, home_prices, prices, earnings, income, spending, jobs, job_finding, unemployment, delinquency, interest_rates, stocks or government_debt; default the headline of each, latest month.

name: consumer_expectations

outputSchema.description: rows are each topic's headline measure in the order of columns (an expected change or a chance, in percent, the latest month beside the month and the year before); with topic, rows are months with every measure the survey gives.

title: Consumer expectations (New York Fed survey)
